Topic: Impact of COVID-19 on Patient Access to Services

Clues (max 200 words): 
- "the patients in-flow dropped drastically."
- "the hospital was empty."
- "patients thought that they will catch the virus if they come to the hospital."
- "patients stayed back at home."
- "In the middle and at the start of the outbreak, there was a decrease in the caseloads because patients were afraid to visit hospitals."
- "Now they are coming."

Reasoning (max 150 words):  
The clues collectively illustrate a significant decline in patient access to services due to COVID-19. The drastic drop in patient inflow and empty hospitals reflect widespread fear among patients of contracting the virus when seeking care. This fear resulted in a substantial decrease in hospital visits, particularly during the initial stages of the pandemic. However, as safety measures were implemented and time passed, patients began to regain confidence and return to healthcare facilities. This evolution underscores the critical impact of patient perception on healthcare accessibility during a pandemic.
